_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 05 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the rich SupplierInvoiceDetail Vue view onto the SupplierInvoiceDetail manifest page. The plain generated detail page lives in slice 01's fragment; this fragment overlays a kind=page custom component that adds the OCR-confidence indicator, Peppol/UBL provenance block and the related ThreeWayMatch placeholder. Registered as kind=page custom component in src/registry.js.

pages.title: Supplier Invoice
pages._note: `type: detail` renders declared fields of ONE object. This page must additionally render (a) the parsed `lines[]` embedded in the invoice — a nested array, not a related collection with a foreign key, so config.relatedCollections cannot fetch it; (b) an OCR-confidence indicator that only exists when the invoice arrived through the PDF/OCR ingest path; and (c) the UBL/Peppol provenance block, present only on Peppol-ingested invoices. Both (b) and (c) are conditional on HOW the record was ingested, which no declarative field list expresses.
